resources.string: Export settings and custom themes, or restore them after reinstalling

Back up settings and custom themes here. Back up your dictionary separately in Dictionary and backup. Save both backups before uninstalling. Settings backups include custom theme images; keep them in a trusted location.
Choose folders, allow contact access, and enable automatic features

Replace input, keyboard, and theme settings with this backup? Your dictionary stays as it is. Automatic backup and Rime automatic sync will be off. After importing, you can choose folders, restore your dictionary, and enable these features.
Please wait for the result before closing this page.
Settings exported. Back up your dictionary too before uninstalling.
Settings imported. Complete the remaining restore steps below.
Settings export failed. Check the selected storage location and export again before uninstalling.
This settings backup could not be read. Choose a complete backup exported by a supported version.
Settings restore did not finish. Some settings may have changed. Check available storage and import again.
